fullDescription: Dark navy multi-step form wizard landing page with one warm amber accent: hero register card with a gradient progress bar, step ticks, active focus field, Back/Continue nav and step dots, plus patterns, library and pricing.
prompt:
## Resumo
A dark, premium 'Stepwise' form-SaaS landing page built around a hero multi-step wizard card. A sticky translucent navy nav sits above a two-column hero: left is the headline + value copy + CTAs, right is a glowing register wizard card (Step 1 of 4) with a gradient progress bar, labeled step ticks, a grouped name field-pair with an active focus state, an @-prefixed display-name input, Back/Continue step nav, and a footer of progress dots + autosave reassurance. Below: a trusted-by strip, a 6-card 'anatomy' patterns grid, a 3-step prompt-to-flow timeline, a 3-up pattern library, a 3-tier pricing block with a featured middle plan, a glowing CTA panel and a 4-column footer. Single warm amber accent on a deep navy field with a cream ink scale; Inter throughout; rounded-xl/2xl cards, soft inset hairlines, ambient blurred glows, and a faint dotted grain texture.

## Estilo Visual
Design a dark, premium form-SaaS landing page using Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900), antialiased. Build a custom navy palette: navy DEFAULT #0b1f3a (page bg), navy-700 #102a4d (cards/fields), navy-600 #163661, navy-deep #081729 (darkest sections + nav blur); a cream ink scale: cream #f4efe3 (headings/bright text), cream-soft #cdd6e3 (body), cream-muted #9fb0c8 (captions/labels), with hairlines as cream at 8-14% opacity; and a single amber accent: amber #f0b429, amber-600 #d99a16, amber-soft #f7d479. Reserve amber strictly for the brand mark, active step + step ticks, focus rings, primary buttons, progress-bar fill, the active progress dot and key check/icon accents. Primary buttons use a top-lit gradient (linear-gradient(180deg,#f7c948 0%,#f0b429 100%)) with an amber drop glow (0 8px 22px -8px rgba(240,180,41,.7)) and an inset top highlight, navy-deep #081729 text, and lift -translate-y-0.5 on hover. Fields sit on navy-700 #102a4d with a 1px cream/14% border; on focus/active they shift to #0d2444 with an amber #f0b429 border and a 3px rgba(240,180,41,.22) focus ring; placeholders are #5d6f8c. Cards are rounded-2xl/22px on navy-700 with an inset cream/8% hairline + a deep shadow (0 40px 90px -40px rgba(0,0,0,.65)); the featured pricing card and selected states get a glow-amber ring (0 0 0 1px rgba(240,180,41,.35), 0 22px 60px -28px rgba(240,180,41,.55)). The sticky nav uses rgba(8,23,41,.72) + 14px backdrop-blur. Add ambient blurred radial glows (amber/10 and navy-600/40, blur-3xl) and a faint dotted grain (radial-gradient dots of cream/8% on a 22px grid) on hero/dark sections. Headings are font-black tracking-tight (hero 40px up to 54px); uppercase eyebrows are 12px semibold with 0.18-0.2em tracking in amber. Selection is amber bg / navy-deep text.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (h-16, z-50) on rgba(8,23,41,.72) with 14px backdrop-blur and a bottom cream/10 hairline, inside a max-w-[1180px] px-6 container. Left: brand lockup = an 8x8 rounded-lg amber-gradient tile holding a navy-deep ph:steps-bold icon, the extrabold 17px cream wordmark 'Stepwise', and an uppercase 10px tracked 'Form Lab' pill (cream/15 border, cream-muted) shown from sm. Center (md+): nav links Builder / Patterns / Library / Pricing in 14px medium cream-soft with amber hover. Right: a 'Sign in' text link (sm+) and a primary amber-gradient 'Start free' button (rounded-lg, navy-deep bold text, hover lift).

### Hero (left copy column)
A max-w-xl column: a pill eyebrow (rounded-full, amber/30 border on amber/10, ph:sparkle-fill + 'Multi-step forms, designed for completion' in amber-soft). Then an H1 'Forms people / actually finish.' at 40px rising to 54px, font-black tracking-tight, with 'actually finish.' in amber on its own line. A 17px cream-soft lead paragraph. A button row: a primary amber-gradient 'Generate a wizard' (ph:magic-wand-bold) and a ghost 'Browse patterns' (cream/20 border). Below, a wrap of three 13px cream-muted check items (amber ph:check-circle-fill): 'Accessible by default', 'Copy as React or HTML', 'No design tax'.

### Hero (multi-step wizard card)
The centerpiece on the right: a rounded-[22px] navy-700 card with a deep card-edge shadow + inset cream/8% hairline, wrapped in a soft amber/5 blurred glow. Header strip (border-b cream/10, px-7): an uppercase 11px tracked cream-muted kicker 'Create your account', a 22px extrabold cream 'Register' title, and a right tabular 'Step 1 / 4' chip (rounded-lg, cream/15 border, navy-deep/60 fill). Progress block: a row of 4 step labels (active 'Name' in amber, the rest cream-muted, the trailing three hidden below the xs/390px breakpoint where 'Name' shows an inline '· Step 1/4'), then a 1.5px tall rounded track (navy-deep/80 + inset ring) with an amber-gradient fill at width:25%. Step body: a 'Full name *' label (amber asterisk), a 2-col grid of two inputs — the first 'First name' in the ACTIVE state (amber border + ring, value 'Ada'), the second empty 'Last name' — each with an 11px cream-muted helper ('Given name' / 'Family name'); then a 'Display name' label and an input with a leading ph:at icon and 'ada.lovelace' placeholder. Step nav row: a disabled ghost 'Back' button (ph:arrow-left, cream/15 border, cream-muted) and a primary amber-gradient 'Continue' button (ph:arrow-right-bold). Footer strip (border-t cream/10): a left autosave line (amber ph:floppy-disk-bold + 'Progress saved automatically') and right step dots (one wide amber glow-amber pill + three cream/20 dots).

### Trusted-by strip
A full-width band with top+bottom cream/10 hairlines on navy-deep/40, inside the container: a left uppercase 12px tracked cream-muted label 'Trusted in onboarding flows at' and a right wrap of four 15px bold cream-soft logo lockups, each a Phosphor bold icon + name: ph:cube-bold Northwind, ph:planet-bold Orbital, ph:flow-arrow-bold Cascade, ph:lightning-bold Voltline. Reflows to centered stacked on mobile.

### Patterns (anatomy) grid
A bg-navy section: an amber uppercase eyebrow 'The anatomy', a 32-40px font-black cream H2 'Every step, considered.', and a cream-soft lead. Then a gap-5 grid (sm:2, lg:3) of six rounded-2xl cards (cream/10 border on navy-700/70, hover border amber/40), each with an 11x11 rounded-xl amber/10 tile holding an amber Phosphor icon, an 18px bold cream title, and a 14px cream-muted description: Progress that motivates (ph:list-numbers-bold), Fields that flow (ph:text-aa-bold), Back & continue logic (ph:arrows-left-right-bold), Responsive by birth (ph:device-mobile-bold), Keyboard & a11y (ph:keyboard-bold, with Enter/Esc shown as bordered .kbd keycaps), Export-ready code (ph:code-bold).

### Prompt-to-flow timeline
A bg-navy-deep + grain section, two-column (lg:grid-cols-[0.9fr_1.1fr]): left an amber eyebrow 'From prompt to flow', a font-black H2 'Three steps to a finished wizard.' and a cream-soft lead. Right an ordered list of 3 steps over a vertical gradient connector line (amber/60 fading down): each row is a numbered circle (step 1 an amber-gradient navy-deep numeral, steps 2-3 a navy-600 ring-line amber numeral) beside a rounded-2xl navy-700/60 card with a 16px bold cream title + 14px cream-muted body: 'Prompt the form', 'Tune the steps', 'Ship the code'.

### Pattern library grid
A bg-navy section: header row with an amber eyebrow 'Pattern library' + font-black H2 'Start from a proven flow.' on the left and a 'Browse all 80+' amber link (ph:arrow-right-bold) on the right. Then a gap-5 grid (sm:2, lg:3) of three rounded-2xl 'article' cards (cream/10 border on navy-700/60, hover -translate-y-1): each has a 36-tall gradient preview panel (navy-600 to navy-deep) sketching a mini form pattern in bars/dots — a stepper bar variant, a numbered-circle stepper variant, a radio-list with a 40%-filled progress bar — and a body with a bold cream title, a small amber/10 step-count chip ('4 steps' / '3 steps' / '5 steps'), and a 13px cream-muted description: Account signup, Checkout flow, Onboarding survey.

### Pricing block
A bg-navy-deep + grain section, centered intro (amber eyebrow 'Pricing', font-black H2 'Design more, pay less.', cream-soft lead). A gap-6 lg:grid-cols-3 row of three rounded-2xl cards. Side cards (Starter $0/forever, Team $79/month) sit on cream/10 border + navy-700/60 with a 42px font-black tabular price, a cream-muted blurb, a 3-item amber-check feature list, and a ghost outlined CTA. The featured middle 'Pro' card ($24/month) is raised (lg:-mt-4), on an amber/50 border + navy-600-to-700 gradient with a glow-amber ring, a top-centered amber-gradient 'Most popular' pill, an amber uppercase 'Pro' label, a 4-item feature list and a solid amber-gradient 'Start 14-day trial' CTA.

### CTA panel
A bg-navy section holding a single rounded-3xl panel (amber/30 border on a navy-600-to-navy-deep gradient) with a top-centered blurred amber/15 glow: a centered 30-40px font-black cream H2 'Your next form, finished by lunch.', a max-w-xl cream-soft sub, and a centered button row of a primary amber-gradient 'Generate your wizard' (ph:magic-wand-bold) and a ghost 'See the patterns' (cream/25 border).

### Footer
A border-t cream/10 footer on navy-deep: a grid (lg:grid-cols-[1.4fr_1fr_1fr_1fr]) with a brand column (the amber-tile + 'Stepwise' lockup, a cream-muted tagline, and three rounded-lg bordered social icon buttons — ph:x-logo-bold, ph:github-logo-bold, ph:discord-logo-bold, hover amber) and three link columns (Product / Resources / Company) of 14px cream-soft links with amber hover. A bottom bar (border-t cream/10) with a '© 2026 Stepwise Labs' line and Privacy / Terms links in cream-muted.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Multi-step wizard card: a self-contained step container with a header (kicker + title + 'Step 1 / 4' tabular chip), a labeled step-tick row, a gradient progress bar at width:25%, a step body of grouped fields, a Back/Continue step-nav row, and a footer of step dots + autosave note — the whole transferable wizard pattern.

### Componente
Gradient progress bar: a thin rounded track on navy-deep/80 with an inset ring-line and an amber-gradient fill (linear-gradient(90deg,#f0b429,#f7d479)) whose width encodes step completion (25% for step 1/4).

### Componente
Field with active/focus state: a .field on navy-700 #102a4d + cream/14% border that on .field-active OR :focus shifts to #0d2444, an amber #f0b429 border and a 3px rgba(240,180,41,.22) focus ring; placeholder #5d6f8c. The first 'First name' input ships pre-activated to demo the focus treatment.

### Componente
Top-lit amber gradient button (.btn-amber): linear-gradient(180deg,#f7c948,#f0b429) with an amber drop glow + inset top highlight, navy-deep text, used for the brand tile, primary CTAs and numbered step '1'; hover lifts -translate-y-0.5.

### Componente
Disabled ghost 'Back' button: cream/15 bordered, cream-muted, with a leading ph:arrow-left — the inert back-affordance for step 1.

### Componente
Step dots: a horizontal dot group where the active dot is a wide (w-7) amber pill with a glow-amber ring and the rest are small cream/20 dots; mirrors the progress bar in miniature.

### Componente
Icon-led input: a relative field with an absolutely-positioned leading Phosphor icon (ph:at) and left padding for the 'Display name' / @handle input.

### Componente
Grouped field-pair: a 2-col grid of two inputs (First/Last name) each with its own 11px cream-muted helper caption, sharing one 'Full name *' label.

### Componente
glow-amber ring utility: an amber outline + soft amber drop-glow shadow used to lift the active step dot, the featured Pro pricing card and other 'selected/featured' elements.

### Componente
Mini pattern previews: pure-CSS form-flow sketches inside the library cards (stepper bars, numbered-circle steppers with connector lines, radio lists + a 40% progress bar) drawn from divs, not images.

### Componente
Ambient depth layer: blurred radial glows (amber/10, navy-600/40, blur-3xl) plus a dotted-grain background (.grain radial-gradient on a 22px grid) layered behind dark sections.

### Componente
.kbd keycaps: small bordered (cream/18%, thicker bottom border) inline keycaps rendering Enter / Esc in the keyboard-a11y pattern card.

## Notas Especiais
Color discipline is the heart of the design: three navy tones (#0b1f3a / #102a4d / #163661, plus #081729 for the darkest sections and nav blur) carry the entire surface, a cream ink scale (#f4efe3 / #cdd6e3 / #9fb0c8) carries all text at three opacities, and amber (#f0b429 with #f7d479/#d99a16 variants) is the ONLY accent — reserved for the brand mark, the active step + ticks, focus rings, primary buttons, progress fills, the active step dot and key icons, so attention always lands on the path forward. Depth comes from soft inset cream hairlines (not hard borders), deep low card shadows, ambient blurred amber/navy glows and a faint dotted grain rather than heavy elevation. The hero wizard is the reusable centerpiece: it teaches the full multi-step anatomy (header + step chip, labeled progress, grouped fields with an active focus state, Back/Continue gating, step dots, autosave note) and the first field ships pre-activated so the amber focus treatment is visible in a static frame. Layout is fully responsive on a max-w-[1180px] container: the hero two-column collapses to one, the wizard step ticks collapse to a single 'Name · Step 1/4' label at the 390px xs breakpoint, and every grid (patterns, library, pricing) drops to one column on mobile. Icons are Phosphor (ph:) bold; type is Inter throughout. Note this is a static design frame: focus rings, hover lifts, backdrop-blur and progress only animate live, and the 'Stepwise' brand + field copy are illustrative placeholders to swap.

structured.special_notes: Color discipline is the heart of the design: three navy tones (#0b1f3a / #102a4d / #163661, plus #081729 for the darkest sections and nav blur) carry the entire surface, a cream ink scale (#f4efe3 / #cdd6e3 / #9fb0c8) carries all text at three opacities, and amber (#f0b429 with #f7d479/#d99a16 variants) is the ONLY accent — reserved for the brand mark, the active step + ticks, focus rings, primary buttons, progress fills, the active step dot and key icons, so attention always lands on the path forward. Depth comes from soft inset cream hairlines (not hard borders), deep low card shadows, ambient blurred amber/navy glows and a faint dotted grain rather than heavy elevation. The hero wizard is the reusable centerpiece: it teaches the full multi-step anatomy (header + step chip, labeled progress, grouped fields with an active focus state, Back/Continue gating, step dots, autosave note) and the first field ships pre-activated so the amber focus treatment is visible in a static frame. Layout is fully responsive on a max-w-[1180px] container: the hero two-column collapses to one, the wizard step ticks collapse to a single 'Name · Step 1/4' label at the 390px xs breakpoint, and every grid (patterns, library, pricing) drops to one column on mobile. Icons are Phosphor (ph:) bold; type is Inter throughout. Note this is a static design frame: focus rings, hover lifts, backdrop-blur and progress only animate live, and the 'Stepwise' brand + field copy are illustrative placeholders to swap.
